analysis.summary: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported a strong first half of FY27, with pre-sales rising 176% year-on-year to INR879 crores and EBITDA growing 95% to INR155 crores. Management highlighted robust demand in Mumbai's luxury housing market and expanded its portfolio by adding three new projects during the quarter. The company remains confident in achieving its FY27 guidance of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores in pre-sales alongside steady revenue and profit growth. Furthermore, the firm maintains a net cash position of INR494 crores as of September 30, 2026, supporting ongoing execution and upcoming project launches. Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported strong financial and operational results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, driven by growth in pre-sales, revenue, and profitability.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of delivering its FY27 pre-sales guidance ranging from INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores.
guidance.quote: Together with the momentum from our recent launches and a growing pipeline, we remain confident of delivering our FY27 guideline of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA and PAT margins to be between 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively, for FY27.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining strong profitability, with EBITDA and PAT margin expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of delivering stated guidance for FY27 of pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of delivering our stated guidance for FY27 of a pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: The company remains committed to its FY27 guidance of pre-sales between INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.
guidance.quote: Backed by this launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we remain committed to our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

guidance.claim: Management expects to sustain EBITDA margins of 35% to 40% and PAT margins of 25% to 30%.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of sustaining strong profitability with EBITDA and PAT margins expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

demand_outlook.claim: Mumbai remains India's largest housing market with sales in the first nine months of calendar 2026 at their highest since 2018.
demand_outlook.quote: Mumbai remains India’s largest housing market, with sales in the first nine months of calendar 2026 at their highest since 2018, and the luxury segment continues to lead.

demand_outlook.claim: Prime residential prices in Mumbai rose 6.2% year-on-year during the first half of the calendar year.
demand_outlook.quote: In the first half of the calendar year, sales of homes priced above INR10 crores reached a record of over INR18,500 crores, while prime residential prices rose 6.2% year-on-year, more than twice the global average.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is largely driven by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand is driven largely by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations, while scarce land in prime micromarkets makes redevelopment the principal route to new supply, precisely where Lotus has built its capability.

demand_outlook.claim: Management does not expect the recent repo rate hike to materially alter luxury housing demand in their operating micromarkets.
demand_outlook.quote: Our buyers rely far less on home loans and buy for long-term value and lifestyle. We, therefore, do not expect it to materially alter demand in the micromarkets we operate in.

demand_outlook.claim: Lotus Trident contributed pre-sales of INR178 crores in its first full quarter since launch.
demand_outlook.quote: Lotus Trident in Andheri West, our luxury commercial offering, has been a standout performer, contributing pre-sales of INR178 crores in its first full quarter since its launch at the end of June.

demand_outlook.claim: There is strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, alongside high enquiry levels for luxury residential units at the GIFT City project.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, coupled with differentiated project positioning and strong brand name translating into high enquiry levels for luxury residential units.

demand_outlook.claim: Luxury housing demand in Mumbai has grown by more than 11%.
demand_outlook.quote: Even as the overall housing market has moderated, luxury housing demand across the city has grown by more than 11%, led by successful families and professionals upgrading to bigger, better homes.

capex_expansion.claim: Three new projects added during the quarter include Lotus Impressa at Shivaji Park, Lotus Stellar in Versova, and Lotus Supremus in Juhu.
capex_expansion.quote: Three new projects added, Lotus Impressa at Shivaji Park in Dadar West, Lotus Stellar in Versova, and Lotus Supremus in Juhu, which adds INR2,700 to INR2,800 crores of GDV to existing GDV pipeline.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to launch four projects in the second half with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are well-prepared for the second half. We plan to launch four projects, Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects adding INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.
capex_expansion.quote: We also made significant progress on business development during the quarter, where company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects: Lotus Supremus (Juhu), Lotus Empressa (Shivaji Park, Dadar West), Lotus Stellar (Versova) and additional area secured for Lotus Insignia which together adds INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded into the GIFT City Area with a flagship ultra-luxury mixed-use project via a Joint Development Agreement with Mr. Abhishek Bachchan.
capex_expansion.quote: Agreement type: Joint Development Agreement with profit sharing arrangement with Mr. Abhishek Bachchan

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched two new projects in Q1 FY27 with a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, together representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27 with a combined GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we plan to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Total revenue for Q2 FY27 rose 53% year-on-year to INR269 crores with EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores at a 39.9% margin.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% year-on-year to INR269 crores. EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores, with margins expanding to 39.9%.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY27 revenue stood at INR401 crores, EBITDA at INR155 crores, and PAT at INR134 crores with a PAT margin of 33.5%.
margins_costs.quote: For the first half, revenue stood at INR401 crores, up 69%, EBITDA at INR155 crores, up 95%, and PAT at INR134 crores, up 86% at an improved PAT margin of 33.5%.

margins_costs.claim: In Q2 FY27, total revenue rose 53% YoY to INR 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to INR 89 Crs.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% YoY to INR 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to INR 89 Crs.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported a PAT margin of 34.5% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores, at a PAT margin of 34.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Marketing expenses are expected to be approximately 1% of pre-sales.
margins_costs.quote: Of course, our expense would be I would say about 1% approximately, but that also will be able to recover because what happens that during this advertising, there would be many clients we will be getting directly, where we will not be spending any money on brokerage.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: With these additions, our ongoing and upcoming pipeline now comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores, of which 19 are redevelopment-led.

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-sales for Q2 FY27 grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs, while H1 FY27 pre-sales stood at INR 879 Crs.
orders_capacity.quote: Pre-sales for Q2 FY27 grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs. For H1 FY27, pre-sales stood at INR 879 Crs, up 176% YoY and on track to achieve our full-year guidance.

capital_allocation.claim: The company had a net cash position of INR494 crores as of September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: As of 30th September 2026, we had a net cash position of INR494 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: INR305 crores out of IPO net proceeds had been deployed as of September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: INR305 crores had been deployed as on 30th September 2026. We remain on track with our planned utilization schedule.

capital_allocation.claim: As of June 2026, the company had a net cash position of INR623 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of June 2026, we had a total cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that luxury buyers are not driven by loan rates, but acknowledged broader market uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: While most buyers globally are being cautious, given interest rates and broader uncertainty, luxury buyers are not.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to launch four projects, namely Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, in the second half.
management_commitments.quote: We plan to launch four projects, Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains confident of delivering the FY27 guidance of pre-sales between INR1,800 crores and INR2,000 crores.
management_commitments.quote: Together with the momentum from our recent launches and a growing pipeline, we remain confident of delivering our FY27 guideline of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60% over FY26 levels.

management_commitments.claim: Four launches are planned in H2 FY27, namely Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, Lotus Odyssey, and Lotus Aurelia, with a combined estimated GDV of ~INR 3,500-4,000 Crs.
management_commitments.quote: As we enter the second half, we are well prepared. Four launches are planned, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, Lotus Odyssey, and Lotus Aurelia with a combined estimated GDV of ~INR 3,500-4,000 Crs.

management_commitments.claim: The expected commencement of the GIFT City Area project is in Q1 FY28 with completion slated for FY31.
management_commitments.quote:
Completion Timeline: FY31
❖ Expected Commencement: Q1 FY28

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to dilute promoter stake to 75% or below within the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: So, we have got total three years. One year has passed, so we have still two years to go. And within that time, I think we'll be able to dilute that.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to collect around INR1,000 crores in cash this year.
management_commitments.quote: So, this year we are intend to collect around INR1,000 crores.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
